name: ai.flydocs/flydocs

isolation.method: unavailable on this host (no unprivileged user/network namespaces) - server processes ran with normal network egress

handshake.error: handshake: ExceptionGroup: ExceptionGroup: MCPError: Connection closed

errors: handshake: ExceptionGroup: ExceptionGroup: MCPError: Connection closed
CLI-style package: prints usage/help and exits when invoked bare (no MCP server subcommand declared in registry metadata)
stderr_tail:
out      Revoke this machine's API key and delete it locally
    whoami      Show who you are signed in as and where the key comes from
    scan        Generate project context with a server-side AI scan
    rules       Evaluate and adopt workspace rule files
    clean       Remove legacy artifacts (--v1 for pre-migration cleanup)
    cloud       Learn about FlyDocs Cloud and upgrade from local
    telemetry   Manage anonymous usage analytics
    otel        OTLP auth headers for Claude Code (`otel headers`, run by its helper)
    uninstall   Remove FlyDocs from a project

  Aliases: sync → update, self-update → update, cleanup → clean --v1, upgrade → cloud, install → init, auth → login --with-key

  Run flydocs <command> --help for options. Agent commands like /activate run in your IDE.
